svg.title: Iron Grind Fitness Gym — Complete Level 1 Data Flow Diagram
svg.desc: Complete Gane–Sarson Level 1 DFD showing nine processes, external entities, and individually identified data stores with labeled flows.
svg.text: Iron Grind Fitness Gym — Complete Level 1 DFD
Gane–Sarson notation · nine main processes · individually identified data stores · labelled data flows
Read flows point from a store to a process; write flows point from a process to a store. Repeated store IDs refer to the same logical store.
D12 is reserved and has no active frontend process dependency in the current documented model. D15–D17 are included in Process 1.0.
